sharedContract.cacheState: First request empty expert cache; second retains it while resetting generation. OS caches not cleared.
sharedContract.measurement: Existing full-logit cost observer; same observation overhead both arms; no GPU timestamp instrumentation on primary runs.

invariants.existingServices: 27B and local experimental Flash-Next left running; shared-host experiment, no service restarts.

gates.parity: All output IDs and complete full-vocabulary logits must be bit-exact for matched requests. Failure blocks promotion.
gates.resource: Per-process GPU accounting must preserve existing allocation reserve; live GTT and system memory admission plus provider PID checks before every process.
gates.performance: Report per-request and per-decode-interval raw values, total decode time divided by actual decode intervals; never sum overlapped reader durations into latency. No population or service-SLA claim from this sample.
gates.qualification: Existing long-context source-reference gate remains unchanged and open.

mechanism: Cache exact assembled Q4K expert chunks in their loader owner after read/upload, with bounded reservations. No generic file cache, new weight copies, dtype, shader or routing change.
